family.description: This domain is found in many multi-domain enzymes which synthesise peptide antibiotics. This domain catalyses a condensation reaction to form peptide bonds in non- ribosomal peptide biosynthesis. It is usually found to the carboxy side of a phosphopantetheine binding domain ([pfam:PF00550]). It has been shown that mutations in the HHXXXDG motif abolish activity suggesting this is part of the active site [[cite:PUB00007135]].
family.name: Condensation domain
